paper_title: Can Language Models Follow Multiple Turns of Entangled Instructions
caption: consists of 1.1K spanning across three levels of difficulty and 9 capabilities, with balanced numbers of samples in each capability (numbers shown in the figure). Table <ref> provides a more detailed list of task descriptions.

annotations.annotation: The pie chart represents three categories related to certain tasks or features in inner part, in outer part totaling 9 slices, three under each inner slice. The slices and their corresponding labels are as follows: For the inner slice "Contradiction Resolution", the outer slices are: "Prioritization" with a value of 100, colored light red; "Personalization" with a value of 100, colored red; "Privacy Protection" with a value of 111, colored dark red; For the inner slice "Context Retrieving", the outer slices are: "Multitasking" with a value of 160, colored dark teal; "Dynamic Instruction" with a value of 100, colored teal; "Memorization" with a value of 100, colored light teal; For the inner slice "Context Tracking", the outer slices are: "Triggering" with a value of 100, colored light blue; "Recursive Reasoning" with a value of 110, colored blue; "Dynamic Environment" with a value of 100, colored dark blue; "Contradiction Resolution", "Context Tracking", and "Context Retrieving" are central elements with a visual emphasis. The chart includes values and labels outside the slices, aiding quick reference to their values. The segments do not appear to be ordered in any particular manner. No legend is given.

The pie chart represents various categories related to certain tasks or features, totaling 3 inner slices and 9 outer slices. Each of the inner slices labeled as "Context Retrieving", "Content Tracking", and "Contradiction Resolution" is further divided into 3 outer slices. "Contradiction Resolution" contains the slices of "Prioritization" with a value of 100, colored light red; "Personalization" with a value of 100, colored light red of different shade and "Privacy Protection" with a value of 111, colored red; while "Context Retrieving" contains the slices of "Multitasking" with a value of 160, colored teal; "Memorization" with a value of 100, colored light teal; "Dynamic Instruction" with a value of 100, colored light teal; Meanwhile the outer slices of "Context Tracking" contains "Triggering" with a value of 100, colored blue; "Recursive Reasoning" with a value of 110, colored dark blue; "Dynamic Environment" with a value of 100, colored blue; "Contradiction Resolution", "Context Tracking", and "Context Retrieving" are central elements with a visual emphasis. The chart includes labels inside inner slices, as well as labels on the side of outer slices, aiding quick reference to their values. The segments do not appear to be ordered in any particular manner.

The pie chart represents various categories related to certain tasks or features, totaling 9 outer slices for subcategories and 3 inner slices for the 3 main categories.
